item.title: Equal treatment for computer engineering in Spain's LSCP (change.org petition, 2013)
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Equal treatment for computer engineering in Spain’s LSCP (change.org petition, 2013)
A change.org petition started on 15 April 2013 by CCII - CONCITI, asking the Ministry of Economy and Competitiveness (minister Luis de Guindos) to treat computer engineering like the other engineering degrees in the future law on professional services and associations (LSCP; “LSP” in the 2013 title). It closed with 19,297 signatures.
